hero.eyebrow: For people who take the bar seriously
hero.title: Train like it’s logged.
hero.subtitle: powerlog is a precision instrument for strength. Log every set, watch your estimated 1RM and PRs move in real time, and read the progress that’s actually there — not the story you tell yourself.
hero.noCard: Free forever for solo lifters · No card required

features.title: Everything the bar deserves. Nothing it doesn’t.
features.subtitle: A fixed exercise catalog, a clean log, and the math that turns reps into a verdict.

planActual.title: Plan vs. actual, every set
planActual.body: Program targets — weight, reps, RPE or RIR — then log what really happened beside them. powerlog keeps intent and reality on the same line, so honesty is the default.

e1rm.title: e1RM & automatic PRs
e1rm.body: Epley estimates from your real top sets, with personal records surfaced the moment you hit them.

honest.title: Analytics that don’t lie
honest.body: Volume, intensity and 1RM trends per lift — grouped straight from the database, scoped to you.

units.title: kg or lb, canonical
units.body: Log in either unit. Weights are stored canonically and shown in your preference, never rounded wrong.

history.title: History & streaks
history.body: Every session, keyset-paginated and fast — with the streaks that keep you under the bar.

roles.title: Built for coaches and athletes
roles.body: Coaches plan sessions straight into an athlete’s log; athletes train and record the real numbers. One link, two views, zero spreadsheets.

analytics.title: The truth, grouped by lift.
analytics.body: Total volume, heaviest weight, best e1RM and PRs — computed in a single pass over your logged sets and scoped to you. Filter by date, compare blocks, and let the trend make the call on whether the program is working.
bullets: Per-exercise volume & intensity
Best estimated 1RM and PR history
Date-range and block comparisons

coaching.title: Two roles. One source of truth.
coaching.body: Invite by username, accept in a tap, and you’re linked. Coaches program; athletes execute. Everyone sees the same numbers — no exported sheets, no version drift.

coach.title: Plans the work
coach.body: Build the session straight into your athlete’s log — authorized only for the lifters you actually coach.

athlete.title: Logs the truth
athlete.body: Open what your coach planned, train it, and record what actually moved. The history is yours forever.
lines: See planned sessions in the bell

cta.title: The bar doesn’t care how you feel. Log it.
cta.body: Join the lifters who replaced the notes app with an instrument. Free to start, yours to keep.

pricing.title: Free to lift. Pay to go further.
pricing.body: Logging, PRs and progress are free, forever. The paid plans add the work that saves you time — mesocycle planning, the AI assistant, and coaching a roster.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how powerlog collects, uses and protects your personal data when you use our website and application. We process your data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

sections.heading: Data controller
body: The controller of your personal data is Rafa Garcia, with registered address at Cordoba, Spain, Spain. For any question about this policy or your data, write to us at {email}.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: We collect the following categories of personal data:
bullets: Account data: email address, display name and an encrypted (hashed) password.
Profile data: avatar image, preferred units, language and role (athlete or coach).
Training data: workouts, sessions, exercises, sets, weights, RPE and related notes you log.
Billing data: your subscription plan and payment status. Card details are handled directly by our payment providers (Stripe and PayPal) and are never stored on our servers.
Technical and usage data: IP address, device and browser information, pages visited and product interactions, collected for analytics, performance and security.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis
body: We process your data for the following purposes and on the following legal bases under Article 6 GDPR:
bullets: Providing the service and managing your account — performance of the contract with you.
Processing subscriptions and payments — performance of the contract and compliance with legal obligations.
Product analytics and performance monitoring — your consent and/or our legitimate interest in improving the service.
Security, fraud prevention and abuse detection — our legitimate interest and legal obligations.
Service communications (e.g. email verification, billing notices) — performance of the contract.

sections.heading: Recipients and processors
body: We share data only with providers that process it on our behalf under a data processing agreement:
bullets: Payment processing: Stripe and PayPal.
Transactional email: our email delivery provider.
Hosting and infrastructure: our cloud and server providers.
Analytics and telemetry: our self-hosted observability stack and product-analytics provider.
sections.note: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. In such cases, transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We keep your personal data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we erase or anonymise your data within a reasonable period, except where we must retain certain records (e.g. invoices) to comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may exercise the following rights at any time by contacting us at {email}:
bullets: Access to your data.
Rectification of inaccurate data.
Erasure ('right to be forgotten').
Restriction of processing.
Data portability.
Objection to processing based on legitimate interest.
sections.note: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD, www.aepd.es) if you believe your rights have not been respected.

sections.heading: Security
body: We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit, hashed passwords and tokens, signed authentication tokens and strict access controls.

sections.heading: Minors
body: The service is not directed to children under 14. We do not knowingly collect data from minors below the age required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced through the service, and the 'last updated' date above will reflect the latest revision.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of powerlog. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: Acceptance of the terms
body: By accessing or using powerlog you accept these terms in full. If you do not agree with them, you must not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
body: powerlog is a training tracker for lifters and coaches. It lets you log workouts, plan sessions and mesocycles, review analytics and, on paid plans, use AI-assisted planning. We may add, change or remove features over time.

sections.heading: Your account
body: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use.

sections.heading: Plans, subscriptions and payments
body: Some features require a paid subscription. By subscribing you agree that:
bullets: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period until cancelled.
You can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for.
Upgrades take effect immediately with a prorated charge; downgrades take effect at the end of the current period.
Payments are processed by Stripe and PayPal; card data is handled by them, not by us.
Subscriptions are non-refundable, except where required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Coach and athlete features
body: A coach and an athlete can link with each other. When linked, the coach may program sessions and mesocycles and review the athlete’s training. Either party can end the link. The athlete always retains ownership of their own data.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: You agree not to:
bullets: Use the service for any unlawful purpose or in breach of these terms.
Attempt to access accounts or data that are not yours.
Disrupt, overload or attempt to compromise the security of the service.
Copy, resell or exploit the service without our written permission.

sections.heading: Your content
body: You own the training data and content you create. You grant us the limited licence needed to host, process and display that content solely to provide the service to you (and to any coach you link with).

sections.heading: Health disclaimer
body: powerlog is a tracking and planning tool, not medical, health or professional coaching advice. Strength training carries inherent risks. Consult a qualified professional before starting or changing a training programme. You train at your own risk and are solely responsible for your health and safety.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: The software, design, trademarks and content of powerlog (other than your own data) are owned by us or our licensors and are protected by intellectual-property law.

sections.heading: Disclaimers and limitation of liability
body: The service is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we exclude implied warranties and are not liable for indirect or consequential damages. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
body: We may suspend or terminate your access if you breach these terms or use the service in a way that harms others or us. You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time.

sections.heading: Changes to the terms
body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be announced through the service; continued use after they take effect means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Governing law and jurisdiction
body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute will be subject to the competent courts of Spain, without prejudice to the mandatory rights of consumers.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any question about these terms, write to us at {email}.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies and similar technologies powerlog uses, why we use them and how you can manage them. It complements our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: What are cookies
body: Cookies are small files that a website stores on your device. We also use similar technologies (such as local storage) for the same purposes. They let the service work correctly, remember your preferences and understand how the product is used.

sections.heading: Cookies we use
body: We use the following categories:

head: Cookie / technology
Purpose
Type
rows: Understand usage and improve the product

sections.heading: Legal basis
body: Strictly necessary and preference cookies are exempt from consent under Article 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI-CE, because they are required to provide the service you request. Analytics cookies are only used with your consent, which you can give or withdraw at any time.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
body: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies and change your choice at any time. You can also block or delete cookies through your browser settings, though disabling strictly necessary cookies may prevent parts of the service from working.

sections.heading: Third parties
body: Our payment and analytics providers may set their own cookies when their functionality is used. Their processing is governed by their respective policies.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update this policy as our use of cookies changes. The “last updated” date above reflects the latest revision.
